facts.meaning: For this replication object the marker is a locally sampled time written during initialization or a reached contact-refresh branch. A pipeline timeout completion can reach such a branch without a delivered remote response. The marker does not uniformly assert actual remote contact, term agreement or successful replication.

identity.peer: s.peer server identity within that allocation

facts.validity_context: Local leader-state generation. Initialization supplies a grace marker; concurrent RPC completion paths overwrite it. Lease interpretation is relative to current local time and latest configuration.
representation: followerReplication.lastContact protected by lastContactLock; initialization occurs before publication
facts.recovery: A fresh replication object receives a fresh marker; crash/restart behavior is not mapped.
unknowns: Configuration changes may replace or remove peer context; unread branches must be mapped before claiming applicability across membership changes.
Other consumers beyond acquired LastContact call sites are not exhaustively mapped.
Pipeline-timeout path is source-derived; actual same-future execution, marker refresh and lease effects remain unmeasured.

facts.meaning: This particular appendFuture has completed with command timed out and was published to the pipeline consumer without copying a remote response in that timeout branch.

identity.future: appendFuture allocation retaining args and resp pointers

facts.validity_context: In-memory pipeline, positive transport timeout, timeout branch selected and doneCh publication completed.
representation: appendFuture error completion and doneCh item; unchanged response storage
facts.recovery: No restart assertion; pipeline shutdown can cancel publication.
unknowns: Remote request processing may have happened despite no response being selected; timeout alone does not prove no remote processing.
